settlement_source: PGA TOUR (pgatour.com) official leaderboard; Source Agencies: governing league, AP, ESPN, WSJ, Fox Sports (ACHIEVEMENTS.pdf)
settlement_variable: Player leading (first place) at end of Round 1 of the specified tournament (e.g. 2026 VidantaWorld Mexico Open)
timezone: ET for expiration (10:00 AM ET); tournament local time unspecified
tie_handling: Tied leaders: Yes pays $1/N rounded down to nearest cent; No = 1 - Yes payout.
trading_close_vs_settlement: Last trading = expiration time. API close/expiration 2026-11-15T00:00Z is a placeholder; can_close_early=1, so market closes early once Round 1 result is official. Settlement timer 60s.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Postponement: open until reported or 2 weeks after final scheduled event (ambiguous for a Round 1 market). Cancelled/no result: eligible participants pay LAST TRADED PRICE before cancellation, then Outcome Review Committee, then 1/N. Withdrawal/forfeit => No. DQ => No. Truncated event with reported result => that result. Behavior for darkness-suspended Round 1: unknown.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'X leads at the end of Round 1' vs generic achievement template ('held by participant') with no golf-specific rules on suspended rounds or split tees/waves
Placeholder close 2026-11-15 vs actual Round 1 end early Nov 2026
'Leader at end of round' undefined if play suspended
toxicity_flags: Settlement variable (live leaderboard) is public and updating before close: adverse selection vs slow quotes
Wave/tee-time asymmetry: early-wave scores known while late wave plays
Ties common in R1 (1/N payout) make pricing noisy
Placeholder close hides true, abrupt early close
notes: Per-tournament event (VIMO26 in sample). 123 open markets, ~1.84M 24h volume; longshots bid 0.001.
